entries.subject: Archive access and query interface
entries.finding: CASDA's TAP service answered anonymously on 2026-09-17, but downloading images, spectra or visibilities requires an OPAL, CSIRO or Data Central account. Centimetre-wave survey data; no use identified here.
entries.revisitWhen: CASDA allows anonymous downloads, or an ASKAP dataset is needed badly enough to register.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: Survey science data carry no proprietary period, guest science may carry up to 12 months, and targets of opportunity are released at once. A CC BY 4.0 licence is reported for CASDA data but could not be read on a reachable page, so it is unverified; the CASDA and observatory acknowledgement sentences are required.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed for a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software
entries.finding: ASKAPsoft processes ASKAP data and is published under a GPLv3 licence with a CSIRO disclaimer.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.
